name: pau-skills
description: Claude Code skills, hooks and scripts for disciplined agent work: session rituals, verification, subagent orchestration, guards and planning.

plugins.name: session-discipline
plugins.description: Start every session from the written roadmap and close it in a fixed order: retrospective gated by a rules audit, roadmap and log, handoff, commit.

plugins.name: verification
plugins.description: Prove tests can fail: a mutation harness with its three assertions checked by script, a hostile evaluator in a forked context, test-driven development, and a method for deciding how much CI to run and when.

plugins.name: agent-orchestration
plugins.description: Working with subagents: a hook that stops agents from ending their turn idle, an operating methodology where no agent certifies its own work, and an evidence-only codebase oracle.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: PreToolUse guards that mechanize rules that kept being broken: no backticks in inline interpreter payloads, no raw gh pr merge on stacked PRs; plus a safe merge script and a dependency security audit.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Turn an idea into decided, sliced work: a relentless design interview, PRD synthesis, vertical-slice issues, and architecture deepening. Adapted from mattpocock/skills.
